label: VERIFIED
extraction: OpenCode Agent Skills Plugin: Dynamic skills plugin for OpenCode. Requires OpenCode v1.0.110+. Provides 4 tools: skill discovery from .opencode/skills/, .claude/skills/, ~/.config/opencode/skills/, ~/.claude/skills/, ~/.claude/plugins/cache/, ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/. Installation: clone to ~/.config/opencode/opencode-agent-skills, symlink plugin.ts to ~/.config/opencode/plugin/skills.ts. Writing skills: My Skill with instructions. References Anthropic Agent Skills documentation. Alternatives: opencode-skills (auto-discovers, registers as dynamic skills_{{name}} tool), superpowers (complete software development workflow on composable skills), skillz (MCP server exposing skills as tools to any MCP client).
